story: At 6:17 on a sunny Friday evening in Sumter Oaks, Gary is at home mixing cornbread batter while Rosa gets her kitchen ready for guests. Out on Magnolia Loop, Donna has moved some of her pink flamingos behind the hedge and is asking Hal to recount them, since the neighborhood committee has a limit and she'd hate to draw its attention before dinner. Hal, watchful as ever, stands on the street counting flamingos against that limit.
events: Gary (gary fridge): Mix the batter and get the cornbread pan ready for the oven
Hal (donna flamingo flock): Count the flamingos visible from the street against the L-02 limit
Rosa (rosa kitchen): Give the sides a last stir, wipe the counter, and get the dinner ready to serve as guests arrive

gary.thought_process: It's 6:17 PM and Rosa's Friday dinner is tonight. I started the cornbread last tick, so the buttermilk and eggs are already out. Nobody's around, and the cart has to stay parked until Hal and Architectural Review sign off, so there's no sense fiddling with it. The best thing I can do is get the cornbread baked and ready to carry over so I show up on time with what I promised.

parameters.content: Mix the batter and get the cornbread pan ready for the oven

donna.thought_process: Hal just told me there are still more than three birds visible and he wants it fixed by Saturday. My own memory says I pulled the extras behind the hedge and straightened the flock, so I think we're fine, but he's standing right here with binoculars and I'd rather settle it now than have it hang over Friday dinner. I'll keep it friendly, tell him I've already moved the extras out back, and invite him to recount. That keeps the peace, keeps him on my side for the dinner, and doesn't repeat anything I've already said to him.

parameters.content: Hal, honey, I just moved the extras behind the hedge, so you should be seeing exactly three from here. Count again and tell me if I'm off, I'd hate for the committee to get involved right before Rosa's dinner.

hal.thought_process: I already told Donna the three-bird limit and my Saturday deadline last tick, and she's straightening the flock. No sense nagging her again. Better to see for myself: count what's visible from the street and see if the tally matches L-02. Soft spot says give her the benefit of the doubt, but rules are rules, and Gary's cart is still on my list.

parameters.content: Count the flamingos visible from the street against the L-02 limit

rosa.thought_process: It's 6:17 PM and the table is set, the sides are covered, and I already checked my shift schedule, so nothing is conflicting with tonight. The kitchen is the last thing I keep fussing over. No one is here yet, so I shouldn't wander off. One more quick pass on the food, then I can take a breath and be ready to greet Gary, Donna, and Hal at the door.

parameters.content: Give the sides a last stir, wipe the counter, and get the dinner ready to serve as guests arrive

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
